narrative.overview: StuMart is a hyper-local campus marketplace and student community app with youthful, energetic Vietnamese college flair. It pairs trustworthy collegiate emerald structure with electric duck gold hero actions, searing blaze tangerine prices, and a warm chalkboard canvas. It strictly bans card-in-card AI slop in favor of open spatial rhythm, edge-to-edge trust bands, and punchy typography.
keyCharacteristics: Strict Anti-Card-in-Card: Zero nested boxes; spatial rhythm, edge-to-edge color bands, and hairline dividers replace lazy card wrappers.
Committed Voltage Palette: Collegiate Emerald (#0B6E4F) anchors structure; Voltage Duck Gold (#FFD21E) commands hero actions; Blaze Tangerine (#FF5722) ignites deal prices.
Expressive Typography Scale: High contrast between Black (900) hero numerals and clean, scannable body text. No weak eyebrows.
Authentic Vietnamese Campus Culture: Local campus meetup spots, verified student trust indicators, and cheerful duck mascot camaraderie.

rules.name: The Anti-Card-in-Card Rule
rules.body: Never nest a card inside another card. Groups of metadata are rendered as inline flow rows or edge-to-edge color bands separated by whitespace, not boxed containers.

rules.name: The Committed Palette Rule
rules.body: Collegiate Emerald (#0B6E4F) owns 30% of structural authority; Voltage Duck Gold (#FFD21E) owns hero delight; Blaze Tangerine (#FF5722) owns urgent deals and pricing. Avoid washed-out pastel scatter.

rules.name: The Heading Strength Rule
rules.body: Headings stand on their own strength without tiny kicker/eyebrow labels. Space above headings must be at least 1.8x the space below.

rules.name: The Warm Canvas Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit on Warm Chalkboard Canvas (#FAF8F2) rather than glaring hospital white, protecting student eyes during night browsing.

dos: Do use high-contrast color pairings (Collegiate Emerald + Voltage Duck Gold + Blaze Tangerine) for bold youthful energy.
Do organize content with whitespace pacing and edge-to-edge tint bands instead of nested card boxes.
Do emphasize prices with heavy ExtraBold/Black weights and Vietnamese currency conventions (e.g. 150.000 đ).
Do maintain a minimum of 48dp x 48dp for all touch targets.
donts: Don't nest cards inside cards (Card-in-Card AI Slop).
Don't use gradient text or blurry colored glow halos.
Don't use washed-out low-contrast gray text or clinical hospital white backgrounds.
Don't place floating kickers or tiny eyebrows above section headings.
